_comment: Copy to settings.json (gitignored) and fill in your real values. Never commit real credentials, hosts, addresses, or names.
_mail_server_note: Set host to your mail provider's IMAP server. SMTP is not used (read-only). IMAP is normally 993/SSL. Verify the port with your provider before first run.

imap._mailboxes_note: ADR-049: folders are DISCOVERED from the server (IMAP LIST) on every run — you do not have to list them. A per-account 'mailboxes' array is optional and does two things: it pins extras (an explicitly named folder is fetched even if it matches exclude_mailboxes) and it is the fallback if LIST ever fails.
imap._exclude_mailboxes_note: Folders discovery refuses to open, matched on the last path segment (case-insensitive) or the RFC 6154 \Junk attribute. Omit to use the default below. Trash is deliberately NOT excluded: deleted mail is still evidence a client wrote to us.

sync._comment: fetch + triage are incremental (UID watermark + results.jsonl gate); on_startup auto-runs one sync in the background each time `email2data serve` boots, then interval_minutes keeps pulling on a schedule so the lenses stay live (ADR-023) — set 0 to disable the periodic loop

llm._provider_options: vertex_gemini (Google Gemini on Vertex, uses gcloud ADC) | anthropic (needs api_key_env)
llm._context_cache: Vertex/Gemini: cache the large stable playbook prefix so it is not re-billed every call. min_chars ~ the model's caching floor (~1024 tokens); best-effort, falls back to the plain path on any error.
llm._tiers: Per-call cost tiers (llm.with_tier, ADR-025). The Projetos UI labels these by COST — Leve/Normal/Profundo — for 'Reprocessar tudo com IA' (ADR-026) and 'Melhorar com IA' (ADR-027). REQUIRED for that choice to mean anything: with_tier is a deliberate no-op on an unknown or absent tier, so without this block every tier silently resolves to llm.model above and the picker would be a lie.

intake._comment: Conversational-intake Telegram worker (ADR-019/-020/-021). Disabled by default. The bot token lives in .env (never here); start the worker with `email2data intake-bot`.
intake._allowlist_note: Default-deny: only these Telegram user ids may use the bot. roster_owner feeds the capture's asserted_by provenance.

paths._captures_dir_note: PRECIOUS intake media (photos/audio); sibling of out/, NOT regenerable — once a capture is scrubbed from Telegram this is the sole copy, so it MUST be in the backup set (data-stores.md).
